content: Magic is believing in yourself, if you can do that, you can make anything happen.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
story:
From the court of Weimar through the storm of the French Revolution, Goethe lived as poet, scientist, and statesman, embodying universal curiosity. Across sixty years refining Faust, he explored the tension between restless ambition and spiritual peace, insisting that humanity's salvation lies in unceasing striving and reverence for nature's organic wholeness.

Confronting the trials of his era, Johann Wolfgang von Goethe recognized that adversity is the ultimate crucible of the human spirit. Rather than seeking an easy path free from friction, he urged seekers to welcome the struggle as the very forge that tempers courage and character.
